name: asynchronia
description: Asynchronia task routing, repository policy references, optional model inventory and cost analysis, scope checks, and evidence workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Route Asynchronia work using repository policy and configured Codex routing.
interface.longDescription: Provides task routing, scope isolation, deployment verification, acceptance evidence rules, and optional reference data for model inventory and official Standard-speed Codex-credit costs. Ordinary engineering uses configured Codex agent-team/model routing. Specialized numbered-bridge workflows remain governed by their current primary repository authority.
defaultPrompt: Follow current root AGENTS.md, AGENTS.override.md, and ORCHESTRATION.md as the repository authority.
Ordinary Asynchronia engineering uses configured Codex agent-team/model routing; the plugin model-selector is not a blocking preflight.
Do not require MODEL_PREFLIGHT_PAUSE, INVENTORY_OK, a user model/effort selection handshake, CONTINUE, or IMPLEMENTATION_ALLOWED for ordinary work.
An absent legacy selector launcher does not block ordinary development. Do not restore it or simulate executable selector output.
For exact numbered bridge commands, follow the current slot-local bridge authority and preserve any specialized selector steps it explicitly requires.
Keep the confirmed model inventory and official Standard-speed Codex-credit rate card as reference authority; do not change them without direct scope authorization.
Preserve scope isolation, collision protection, security checks, pull request and CI requirements, UI/game-logic separation, and user-owned Safari acceptance where applicable.
